items.headline: Stocks slip from records as the 10-year yield hits its highest since 2002
items.summary: The 10-year Treasury yield touched about 5.35-5.36% Wednesday before a strong $39B auction pulled it back; the S&P 500 fell 0.22% to 7,801.77 and the Dow lost 0.66% to 51,179.87, a day after record highs. Futures were lower again early Thursday.

items.headline: Oil tops $100 as Hormuz tanker attacks hit a wartime weekly high
items.summary: Reuters sources say attacks on tankers around the Strait of Hormuz had their worst week since the Iran war began, and Brent was around $104 early Thursday. The IEA is speeding up the rest of its emergency stock release, with diesel first in line.

items.headline: Michael Burry says the market is in the 'denial' stage
items.summary: Burry compares the AI-led rally to the setups before 2000 and 2008, says the denial phase usually lasts 6-9 months, and holds bearish 2027 put options on Nvidia, Palantir and Micron.

items.headline: Indian stocks keep falling after an RBI rate hike and the oil spike
items.summary: Indian shares fell again Thursday as foreign selling, a weak rupee, the recent RBI rate hike, and crude above $100 weighed on the market.

items.headline: Trump announces automatic enrollment in 'Trump Accounts' for about 70M kids
items.summary: Every child under 18 with a Social Security number now has a government-created investment account. Kids born 2025-2028 get a one-time $1,000 Treasury seed, but only after a parent claims the account in the app.

items.headline: Sen. Thom Tillis calls his Hegseth vote the 'biggest regret' of his career
items.summary: In his new book and on his TV tour, the retiring North Carolina Republican criticizes Hegseth and other Trump cabinet picks. Fellow Republicans are pushing back ahead of the midterms.

items.headline: Iran says the Strait of Hormuz stays closed and 'illegal routes' will be blocked
items.summary: An IRGC adviser said the strait remains under Iran's military control until Tehran's demands are met, and that smuggling routes near Oman's coast will soon be shut. This is still developing.

items.headline: Supreme Court weighs whether climate lawsuits against oil companies can go forward
items.summary: In Monday's Suncor v. Boulder argument, the justices sent mixed signals on whether state-law climate suits against energy companies can proceed. Justice Alito sat the case out.

items.headline: 'Artificial', with Andrew Garfield as Sam Altman, is the big festival talker
items.summary: Luca Guadagnino's OpenAI drama opened NYFF to mostly strong reviews, with praise for Garfield's unsettling Altman, though some critics called the satire muddled. It opens December 25.

items.headline: Eva Marie Saint dies at 102
items.summary: The Oscar-winning star of 'On the Waterfront' and 'North by Northwest' died of natural causes at her Los Angeles home.

items.headline: Paramount closes its Warner Bros. Discovery takeover, and the new company is called Skydance
items.summary: The merger, which closed Monday, puts Paramount, Warner Bros., HBO, CNN and their streaming services under one company, now trading as SKYD.

items.headline: Mark Hamill makes a surprise cameo in Mike Flanagan's 'Carrie'
items.summary: Hamill is almost unrecognizable as a fortune teller in episode six of the new Prime Video Stephen King series. 'Carrie' is trending on X.

items.headline: Brewers beat the Padres 3-1 and head back to the NLCS
items.summary: Garrett Mitchell tripled, scored, and robbed Manny Machado in the eighth as MLB's best regular-season team closed out the NLDS 3-1.

items.headline: Dodgers eliminate the Braves and set up an NLCS rematch with Milwaukee
items.summary: Andy Pages' two-run single in the seventh decided a 4-1 Game 4 win. Game 1 of Dodgers-Brewers is Sunday in Milwaukee.

items.headline: Rays sweep the Yankees, helped by a fan-interference call
items.summary: Tampa Bay won Game 3 4-3 after replay took away Anthony Volpe's would-be tying homer and ruled it a double. 'Cashman' is trending on X as the offseason heat starts.

items.headline: Guardians stay alive, beating the White Sox 9-3
items.summary: José Ramírez and Jo Adell starred as Cleveland forced a Game 4. Chicago still leads the ALDS 2-1.

items.headline: Tonight's TNF: Buccaneers (0-4) at Cowboys (2-2)
items.summary: Rookie QB Jalon Daniels makes his first road start for Tampa Bay at 8:15 p.m. ET on Prime Video.

items.headline: OpenAI rolls out GPT-6 with 'Intelligent UI' in ChatGPT
items.summary: Paid tiers get GPT-6 Sol now and Free/Go users get GPT-6 Luna starting today. Answers can now include charts, buttons, forms and other interactive pieces.

items.headline: Anthropic launches Claude Haiku 5.5
items.summary: Anthropic's new small model has a 1M-token context window and, according to the company, costs about 75% less to run than Haiku 4.5.

items.headline: OpenAI posts 722 AI-generated math papers, including a claimed 'quasi-Riemann' result
items.summary: The unreleased model's work includes a claimed zero-free half-plane Re(s) > 7/8 for the zeta function (it does not prove the Riemann hypothesis). Many papers have Lean proofs, but not all are formalized or independently checked, so mathematicians are still reviewing them.

items.headline: Bezos says AI could make one-income families and 3-day weeks possible
items.summary: In a Fox News interview at Blue Origin's Cape Canaveral factory, Bezos argued that AI productivity gains could lead to labor shortages rather than mass unemployment.

items.headline: Hurricane Isaias is strengthening and headed for the northern Gulf Coast
items.summary: At 4 a.m. CDT it had 80 mph winds and was forecast to make landfall between Ocean Springs, MS and the Florida Panhandle late Friday or early Saturday, with 5-7 ft surge in spots. Worth watching for EMS and ED surge and evacuations; this is developing.

items.headline: Flu season is starting about two months early in the West
items.summary: Seattle Children's and other western systems are seeing December-level flu, mostly H1N1. CDC says activity is still low nationally but growing in 48 states, and there's no broad federal vaccine campaign yet.

items.headline: FDA tells a court its mifepristone safety review will run to March 2027
items.summary: In the Louisiana v. FDA case, the agency said study results are due in mid-December, the report by March, and no REMS changes before then.

items.headline: RFK Jr. opens an NIH clinic to study suspected vaccine injuries
items.summary: The plan also proposes paying doctors to report suspected injuries and upgrading adverse-event reporting. Budget, enrollment rules and oversight haven't been disclosed, and experts are wary.

items.headline: WHO is still seeking answers on a Russian plague-lab worker's pneumonia death
items.summary: A 28-year-old at Irkutsk's Anti-Plague Institute died October 2. Russia says contacts tested negative for plague, but WHO says it can't complete a risk assessment without more data. Lockdown rumors on X appear unfounded; this is developing.
